# v0.8.0 validation record

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

**Status: local implementation and integrated verification complete.** The Rust,
WebAssembly, TypeScript, production-build, documentation, dependency-inventory, and
Chromium/Firefox/WebKit gates passed on 2026-09-28. Clean-Git reproducibility,
commit-derived packaging, and tagging remain pending because the supplied workspace is
an extracted source archive without `.git` metadata.

## Functional acceptance

- [x] The launch screen presents a primary FASTA drop target and a smaller annotation
      drop target beneath it, with keyboard-operable file pickers.
- [x] Annotation files remain associated with eligible loaded records and are available
      after the workspace opens.
- [x] Multi-record annotation files are read once, partitioned exact-first across loaded
      FASTA records, bounded by one per-file admission limit, and never duplicated across
      ambiguous chromosome aliases.
- [x] **Explore** is hidden or disabled until sequence input is viewable, then appears
      as a green action; plot preparation and the active DNA helix do not begin before
      it is selected.
- [x] Opening diagonal and off-diagonal grid cells still selects the intended Self and
      Pairwise comparisons.
- [x] A grid-opened comparison shows **Back to grid** and restores the same grid size,
      record selection, cell results, and scroll/focus context without recomputation.
- [x] Leaving the grid-return flow releases the retained grid data and canvases, while
      repeated cell-open/back navigation does not leak or duplicate those resources.
- [x] Directly selected Self and Pairwise modes do not show a misleading grid-return
      action.
- [x] Grid previews use 512 by 512 cells and remain serial, bounded, and capped at six
      selected records rather than enabling per-cell interactive refinement.
- [x] A six-record grid still performs 21 unique comparisons and renders its remaining
      off-diagonal cells as transposed mirrors rather than duplicate computations.
- [x] The default background is true white (`#ffffff`) and the default palette is
      11-color Spectral in the first plot, reset/clear workflow, and image export;
      empty/loading surfaces and direction legends use the same white.
- [x] Palette choices are grouped as sequential, diverging, and qualitative and match
      the implemented ColorBrewer catalog: 18 sequential, 9 diverging, and 8
      qualitative schemes.
- [x] The discrete color-count control exposes the correct scheme-specific minimum and
      maximum (3–9 sequential, 3–11 diverging, and 3–8/9/12 qualitative), clamps
      safely when palettes change, renders exactly that many color classes, and
      recolors existing tiles without recomputation.
- [x] Similarity exports use the selected ColorBrewer scheme and color count; terminal
      exact and orientation modes retain their categorical/directional semantics.
- [x] The Export image label fits its button at supported viewport sizes and zoom
      levels.
- [x] Visible product identity, npm metadata, citation metadata, SBOM output, release
      archives, and repository links use `moddotplot-interactive`.
- [x] The SBOM and third-party notices identify the embedded ColorBrewer 2 scheme data,
      its Apache-2.0 license, and its authorship/source attribution.
- [x] The compatibility-sensitive Rust crate names remain `moddotplot-core` and
      `moddotplot-wasm`, and generated Wasm imports continue to resolve.
